description: This file defines configuration options and functions for setting up the 'app' component of the Mattermost server, including store overrides, configuration, licensing, logging, clustering, and metrics.

methods.name: StoreOverride
methods.description: Sets a custom store override for the server.

methods.name: StoreOverrideWithCache
methods.description: Overrides the store with a cached version.

methods.name: StoreOption
methods.description: Applies a store option to the server.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configures the server with a data source name, read-only flag, and default configuration.

methods.name: ConfigStore
methods.description: Replaces the configuration store, typically for testing.

methods.name: JoinCluster
methods.description: Joins the server to a cluster.

methods.name: WithLicense
methods.description: Sets the license for the platform.

methods.name: SetLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger for platform services.

methods.name: ServerConnector
methods.description: Connects a Channels instance to the app.
